projectState.summary: Byte 13b-b is implemented on `codex/byte-13b-b` and awaiting review. It adds a browser-side persistence queue in `src/persistence.ts`, Vite dev middleware endpoints under `/api/persistence/status`, `/api/persistence/append`, and `/api/persistence/dump`, batch `appendEvents`, and app wiring for `session.started`, `session.mode_changed`, `song.changed`, and `timing.feel_changed`. The queue schedules flushes outside UI handlers and no persistence call is made from Tone scheduler callbacks or `handleMusicalEvent`. The persistence schema now uses `beat` and `scheduled_beat` columns. `musical.event_recorded`, replay, fork UI, checkpoint restore, moments, compaction, and media export remain deferred.
